# A lambda's parameter named like a prop of the component it is written in
# is the lambda's, on every target. picker's handler writes its two-way
# `value` and then maps a list with `func(value string)`: PropBindings read
# the parameter as the value just written, matching the prop by name
# (`propRef`). adder's method maps with `func(n int)` beside its prop `n`:
# the splice substituted the call site's `n` for the parameter
# (`substituteParams`, `innerParams`).

sngl test --platform=none picker.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html picker.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go picker.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go picker.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go picker.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin picker.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none adder.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html adder.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go adder.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go adder.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go adder.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin adder.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'
-- picker.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component picker(:value string = "", @change(v string)) ui.node {
    var taps = 0

    ui.button #pick(text="pick", @click {
        taps += 1
        value = "b"
        var xs list[string] = ["x"]
        change(xs.map(func(value string) => value + "!")[0])
    })
}

component page ui.node {
    var chosen = "a"
    var heard = ""
    var on = true

    if on {
        picker #p(:value=chosen, @change(v) { heard = v })
    }
}

func testTheLambdaReadsItsOwnParam(t test.Test, c page) {
    var p = c.p
    if p != null {
        p.pick.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.chosen == "b")
    t.assert(c.heard == "x!")
}

ui.window {
    page
}
-- adder.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component adder(n int) ui.node {
    var total = 0
    func bump() {
        var xs list[int] = [10, 20]
        total = xs.map(func(n int) => n + 1)[0]
    }
    ui.button #b(text="{total}", @click { bump() })
}

component page ui.node {
    adder #a(n=5)
}

func testLambdaParamNotProp(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.a.b.click()
    t.assert(c.a.b.text == "11")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
